method.scheduling: Three current-code runs, interleaved with unreported comparison runs. No regression tests concurrent with measurements.
method.elapsed: Parent performance.now() around spawnSync of the production CLI, including startup through child completion
method.validation: Preload timestamps exported records() call through DuckDBInstance.create() invocation; includes temporary spill directory creation after parsing
method.engineThroughExit: DuckDBInstance.create() invocation through process exit, including report publication and cleanup
method.memory: Child process.resourceUsage().maxRSS at exit, in KiB; excludes parent measurement process
method.summary: Independent medians of timings and maximum process high-water mark across the three current-code runs
method.output: Temporary working directories; every report byte-compared against saved first baseline output; repository reports untouched
method.scope: Existing approximately 1 GB input only, native Windows; no synthetic comparison, Docker performance, or larger-file extrapolation
method.correctnessLimit: No independent recomputation of the full dataset aggregates
